Name: Jehu the Antothite
Summary: One of those who came to David at Ziklag, called the Antothite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:3: One of those who came to David at Ziklag, called the Antothite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehu in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
